item.title: Create a Windows Wi-Fi Hotspot: Internet Sharing and Troubleshooting
item.description:
A Windows laptop or desktop with a supported wireless adapter can share an Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or cellular Internet connection without third-party hotspot software.

Use the built-in settings

On current Windows releases:

  1. Open Settings → Network & internet → Mobile hotspot.
  2. Choose the Internet connection to share.
  3. Select Wi-Fi as the sharing method when available.
  4. Edit the network name and use a strong, unique password.
  5. Turn on Mobile hotspot, then connect the other device using those credentials.

The exact labels can vary by Windows release and hardware. Older netsh wlan set hostednetwork instructions depend on a legacy hosted-network driver and are no longer supported by many modern adapters, so the Settings interface is the preferred method.
